page_description: Learn about how BiuBiu Tools collects, uses, and protects your data.
title: Privacy Policy

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: BiuBiu Tools is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our Web3 tools and services.

data_collection.title: Data We Collect
data_collection.intro: We collect different types of data depending on your consent preferences:

necessary.title: Essential Data (Always Collected)
necessary.item1: Session data required for website functionality
necessary.item2: Consent preferences to remember your choices
necessary.item5: RPC performance metrics for optimal network selection

analytics.title: Analytics Data (Cookie-Free, Always Enabled)
analytics.item1: Anonymous usage statistics via Rybbit (page views, feature usage)
analytics.item3: Referral source tracking for our referral program

local_storage.title: Local Storage (Necessary)
local_storage.content: We use your browser's local storage to save data that is essential for the app to function. This data stays on your device and is not transmitted to our servers:
local_storage.item1: Custom token lists you've added (required for token operations)
local_storage.item2: Session data for multi-step operations (required to resume interrupted tasks)
local_storage.item3: Scan results stored in IndexedDB (required for balance scanning feature)

third_party.title: Analytics
third_party.content: We use Rybbit (tj.appsdata.org), a privacy-focused, cookie-free analytics service to understand how visitors use our website. Rybbit does not use cookies, does not collect personally identifiable information, and is always enabled as it complies with GDPR without requiring consent. If we add additional analytics services in the future that use cookies, they will only be loaded with your consent. We interact with blockchain networks (Ethereum, Polygon, etc.) as required by our tools, but we do not store your private keys or seed phrases on our servers.

your_rights.title: Your Rights
your_rights.content: Under GDPR, CCPA, and similar regulations, you have the following rights:
your_rights.item1: Right to access: You can request information about what data we have about you
your_rights.item2: Right to erasure: You can clear your local data at any time through your browser settings
your_rights.item3: Right to withdraw consent: You can change your cookie preferences at any time

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us through our GitHub repository or community channels.
